create_run_repository: create a RunRepository instance with an async session factory for SQLAlchemy-backed run storage
put_run: create a new run record with run_id, thread_id, status, and optional metadata in the database
get_run: retrieve a run record by run_id with optional user_id access control check
list_runs_by_thread: list all runs for a given thread_id ordered by creation time with a limit
update_run_completion: update a run with final status, token counts, and message summaries on completion
